description: Sibling replay fixture for Phase 1202 plan 01 Task 3 (D-17): a mixed pass/fail/no_population per-object verdict case built from the existing OBJ_GOLD_PASS/OBJ_GOLD_FAIL/OBJ_GOLD_EMPTY object ids in fixtures/golden/fixture.json and the R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V rule id. Exists because the frozen fixture.json's own stub DesignState (its 'designState.statePayloadJson' field) carries bare stateId-only members with no objectRef/capturedAtUtc and cannot round-trip through DesignStatePayloadV2Serializer.Deserialize -- this sibling is serializer-valid where that stub is not. See README.md in this directory for the full framing and the frozen-file non-edit guarantee.
derivedFrom: fixtures/golden/fixture.json (reuses OBJ_GOLD_PASS, OBJ_GOLD_FAIL, OBJ_GOLD_EMPTY object ids and the R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V rule id verbatim; that file itself is NOT edited by this fixture)
statePayloadJson: {"version":"2","stateId":"DS_1202_MIXED_REPLAY_01","label":"1202 mixed pass/fail replay","capturedAtUtc":"2026-09-21T12:00:00.0000000Z","objStates":[{"stateId":"OS_1202_C_EMPTY","objectRef":"OBJ_GOLD_EMPTY","label":"Golden Non-Building Object","classIri":"ex:Site","capturedAtUtc":"2026-09-21T12:00:02.0000000Z"},{"stateId":"OS_1202_A_PASS","objectRef":"OBJ_GOLD_PASS","label":"Golden Building Pass","classIri":"ex:Building","capturedAtUtc":"2026-09-21T12:00:00.0000000Z"},{"stateId":"OS_1202_B_FAIL","objectRef":"OBJ_GOLD_FAIL","label":"Golden Building Fail","classIri":"ex:Building","capturedAtUtc":"2026-09-21T12:00:01.0000000Z"}],"paramStates":[{"stateId":"DS_1202_MIXED_PARAMS_01","capturedAtUtc":"2026-09-21T12:00:03.0000000Z","parameters":[{"parameterId":"HeightSlider","displayName":"Height Slider","type":"number","value":42.0}]}],"propStates":[{"stateId":"PS_1202_MIXED_HEIGHT_01","ruleIri":"R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V","dataPropertyIri":"ex:hasHeight","objectRef":"OBJ_GOLD_PASS","propValue":{"parameterId":"hasHeight","displayName":"Has Height","type":"number","value":42.0}}]}

expectedPerObjectVerdicts.note: Mirrors fixture.json's expectedOutcomes row for OBJ_GOLD_PASS against R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V: hasHeight 42.0 <= 75, so the violation body never fires.

Mirrors fixture.json's expectedOutcomes row for OBJ_GOLD_FAIL against R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V: hasHeight 88.5 > 75, so swrlb:greaterThan(?h, 75) is satisfied and the rule is genuinely violated. (fixture.json also asserts a by-design 'unsupported' row for the ObjectPropertyAtom on this same object -- this sibling fixture asserts only the per-object rollup outcome, 'failed', per D-12's precedence: error > failed > ... > passed.)
Mirrors fixture.json's expectedOutcomes row for OBJ_GOLD_EMPTY: it is of class ex:Site, which the rule's ClassAtom never matches -- zero bindings, asserted no_population.
